concerns.text: The plan stores activation variance records under `data/processed/activation_stats/*.npy` (see Project Structure). However, `data-model.md` defines the Activation Variance Record as JSON files (`*.json`) and the corresponding `contracts/activation_schema.schema.yaml` expects a JSON object with fields like `prompt_id`, `layer_name`, `variance`, etc. This file‑type mismatch will cause schema validation failures.

Rotation matrices are saved only as binary NumPy files (`matrix_{i}.npy`). The `rotation_matrix_schema.schema.yaml` contract requires a JSON definition for each matrix (including `cluster_id`, `entropy_range_min`, `entropy_range_max`, `matrix_shape`, `matrix_data_ref`, `derived_from_split`). The plan does not mention generating these JSON metadata files, so the rotation matrix artifacts will not satisfy the contract.

The `results.csv` produced in Phase 3 is described as containing metric columns (FID, CLIP, MSE, inference_time_ms) but the `results_schema.schema.yaml` contract also requires a `rotation_index` field for the dynamic method. The plan does not state that this column will be included, risking schema non‑conformance.
